title: Spike: AWS SDK for Rust against the local stand-ins

user_story.i_want: small throwaway programs proving aws-sdk-s3, aws-sdk-sqs and aws-sdk-dynamodb work against RustFS, ElasticMQ and DynamoDB Local
user_story.so_that: we discover protocol and config gotchas before building real features on them

description: Write three examples under `crates/stratum-aws/examples/` and run them with `cargo run -p stratum-aws --example <name>`. This is your first async Rust: `#[tokio::main]`, `.await` and `?` on SDK results. Record findings in `docs/spikes/STR-104-aws-sdk-local.md`. Then promote the working client-building code into `stratum-aws` as reusable constructors that use the local endpoint when configured and real AWS otherwise.

acceptance_criteria.then: it puts an object, lists it by prefix, gets it back and the bytes are equal
it resolves the raw-files queue URL, sends, long-poll receives and deletes a message; a second receive returns nothing
it creates a temporary table, puts and gets an item, then deletes the table
every non-default setting is listed (endpoint URL, path-style, checksum mode, region, credentials) along with whether ElasticMQ's JSON protocol worked

acceptance_criteria.when: a constructor is called with no endpoint configured
acceptance_criteria.then: it falls back to the default AWS config chain (no local overrides)

rust_concepts: The `?` operator with SDK error types
The builder pattern (very common in Rust APIs)
technical_notes: S3 against a non-AWS endpoint needs path-style addressing (`force_path_style`).
If PutObject fails with checksum or signature errors, set request checksum calculation to 'when required'.
Credentials can come from env vars (AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID / AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY) matching your RustFS keys; DynamoDB Local and ElasticMQ accept any values.

references.title: AWS SDK for Rust developer guide
AWS SDKs: S3 data integrity protections (checksum defaults)
The Rust Book ch.17: Async & await

activity.note: T4 implemented by Claude at Rama's request (T1-T3 written by Rama). stratum-aws now exposes AwsSettings, local_credentials() and s3_client/sqs_client/dynamodb_client: an endpoint per service enables local overrides (endpoint, static credentials, S3 path-style); no endpoint falls back to the default AWS chain (AC5, unit-tested). Examples share examples/common/mod.rs and need no AWS_* env vars. Spike notes: docs/spikes/STR-104-aws-sdk-local.md (AC4). Added aws-credential-types to workspace deps. Build 0 warnings; fmt, clippy -D warnings and 4 new tests pass; all three examples verified against the local stack.
